description: The UNLOCK statement (ISO 14.9.47; UNLOCK file [RECORD[S]]) - releases every record lock this connector holds on the file. 2002 introduction; 0900 below 2002.
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014->2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWUN.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           UNLOCK F.
           STOP RUN.
